reviews.t: Kind of cheap and overpriced, but I fixed it.
reviews.x: My hair gets caught on the edges.  I sealed the edges with high temp hot melt glue, but I shouldn’t have had to do that.  Now that I did that, it’s usable.

This is a great copy of the Deva diffuser which retails for $50. It doesn't fit on my John Freida blow dryer, so I kind of Jerry rigged it with electrical tape.  Makes my curls look tight and frizz has been almost eliminated!
The ad should say works best with longer hair.  Didn’t work for me, my hair is chin length and I do not have an abundance of hair like some of the other her curly girls.
To big for my dryer just secured it with duct tape and it does tend to pull hair but does the job.
I didn't expect much after reading some reviews. But it's actually great. It dries pretty fast, and the hair much curlier comparing to air dry
It's much larger than the DevaCurl version, but the price is a bargain.
Love this product, slows my hair to dry with soft curls.

reviews.t: cheaply made. Hair catches on it
reviews.x: My biggest con with this product is that little bits of plastic sharply jut out of this product and my hair catches on it while I'm trying to dry it. It also pops off my hair dryer quite easily. It's still an option... just realize there is a reason it's so cheap. You have to work through the kinks of this product. If you are willing to deal with it, it does dry your scalp quicker however I didn't feel that it helped to add volume to my hair.
I should have purchased this ages ago... works perfectly.

I was wanting a deva curl diffuser, but couldn’t justify the cost so I was hopeful this would work, and it does. The attachment is flexible and fits my BaByliss dryer perfectly. I’ve never used a deva curl diffuser, but I see no need. This exceeded my expectations.

reviews.t: Damaged box and no difference to regular diffuser
reviews.x: Arrived in a pretty damaged box. Takes forever to dry my hair and  dont really see how this makes a difference versus my regular diffuser.
L love this attachment! It evenly distributed the air to my hair. My favorite thing about it is that I can dry bun roots so well!

I will not use it on high speed, high heat, just because ive had the name brand Deva one melt on me. Instead of paying another $40-50, I bought this one. Worth it. I did end up buying a new blow dryer with a smaller nossle, so be warned, the attachment is on the small side. If you have a larger nosed blowdryer, this product isnt for you. Unless you want to just grab a new one.

reviews.t: You get what you pay for
reviews.x: Tried to get the cheap version of a Diva version. I guess. it's true you get what you pay for. My hair got stuck in the seems, it pulled my curls apart.  The plastic was not smooth and my hair got stuck on that also.  Frizz became a constant struggle.  I returned and got he Diva version. LOVE it!!

reviews.t: Works like the real diva curl but very delicate.
reviews.x: The item looks just like the actual deva curl dryer tool and works like it too but the first time I placed it on my dryer, it cracked. Nothing a little superglue wont fix though!
the air (whether hot or cold) does not come out very strong through the holes/slits so it takes waaaay longer to dry curly hair. I'll stick with my round diffuser attachment.
It doesn’t fit on all hair dryers. I would need to tape it to keep it on and the air doesn’t come out as it should. Too light and takes a long time to dry.
I love this product! It dried my curly hair really fast, about 15 minutes compared to the bowl type diffuser I have which takes at least an hour.
I haven’t used it yet but the quality is so/so . The rubber feels like it’s too big around the handle .

reviews.t: Doesn't hang on well but does the job.
reviews.x: I bought this to replace my Deva made diffuser, which was cracking with age and didn't fit the new dryer.  Well, this one doesn't either, it doesn't have a secure connection.  But I saved the very wide rubber band from the Deva one and used it to secure this diffuser and it's working.  More air comes out of the back of the hand than the front, which is odd, but it does reach into the hair to dry the interior, which is the main reason I like this type of diffuser.  So, not perfect but fine for th

reviews.t: Excellent concept especially for curly hair ...if it fits blow dryer.
reviews.x: Well, it doesn't fit my blow dryer which is very disappointing (that knocks it down a point) but I really like how it dries my curls! So I need to hold it to the blow dryer to use it and for $9.99 it's worth it. I never use the hot setting on my blow dryer (a no-no for curlies who don't want the frizzies!) so I don't ever see how it would melt for me.  I really like this product and I would have given it the full 5 stars if it fit my blow dryer!

This is a piece of junk. It's 2 pieces that snap together, however, they do not stay snapped together.  Additionally, there are rough edges which have the potential to actually damage hair or actually cut skin.  I was able to fit it onto my dryer & 5 seconds it popped off.  The ironic thing of it is the box was taped shut & labeled it passed a quality control inspection, lol.  I would not recommend with my last breath.

reviews.t: Excellent dupe, but the quality control isnt great
reviews.x: This is absolutely an acceptable dupe for the deva diffuser, I cant imagine living without it. I bring it everywhere with me! The only issue is the seams arent flush and often grab my hair. I just shake it in circular motions with the air on high to dislodge any tangled hair - so its possible to overlook this. Thats my only complaint! Absolutely in love!!!

First of all it did fit my hair dryer, second, I have natural curly hair (long) and it was 75% dry in 10 minutes.... I tried drying completely but my hair started to frizz, that is because of my hair and not product... A friend let me use her Deva diffuser once and this is exactly like it with same results only your not paying 50.00 .... Love it!!

The quality is exceptionally poor. Poor fit, finish, and craftsmanship. Feels ultra cheap and delicate. There was adhesive goop oozing out of the ring at the base. The product picture does not depict just how cheaply this was made. Should have paid $3 for this item and that’s being generous. Total rip-off at the  $18-$20 price point!

claims.text: Many reviewers find it a good value compared to the pricier DevaCurl version, working similarly for much less money.
Several reviewers report the attachment doesn't fit their blow dryer well and had to secure it with tape or rigging.
A common complaint is that hair catches or snags on rough edges and seams of the plastic.
Many users say it delivers great results, making hair curlier and reducing frizz.
Some reviewers find the build quality cheap or delicate, with cracking or sharp plastic bits.
